title: S3 s3_documents_contrast
objective:
BUG: /ui/documents renders status pills and low-emphasis text below WCAG AA. northstar-os-ui/src/styles/app.css (loaded after tokens.css) hardcodes old colours that were already replaced in tokens.css: .pill-warn color #b8860b and .pill-unknown color #8a8a7a. tokens.css --ochre (#c4941a) is also used as pill text. All are below 4.5:1 on the surfaces they sit on.
REQUIRED BEHAVIOUR: every text-bearing colour the Documents page uses must meet WCAG 2.1 AA against its real background (4.5:1 body, 3.0:1 for text >= 24px). Fix the colour VALUES (tokens and app.css), not the test. Keep the palette recognisably the same family: a darker ochre/unknown/warn, not black. Do not remove the pill classes. app.css must not reintroduce a hardcoded colour that tokens.css already fixed.
CHECK: node northstar-os-ui/scripts/check-contrast.mjs
